added.member: og.ui style tokens (document and style CSS `:root`)
added.summary: Every value the built-in controls draw with is now a CSS variable a style sets in `:root`, and the controls read them back: motion durations (`--motion-duration-*`), easings (`--motion-easing-out`, `--motion-easing-exit`) and the named transitions' springs (`--motion-named-ui-duration`, `-bounce`, likewise panel, emphasis, playful, enter, exit); control states (`--state-hover-wash`, `--state-press-scale`, `--state-control-press-scale`, `--state-lift`, `--state-disabled-opacity`, `--state-touch-disabled-opacity`, the focus and player rings); each input's densities (`--density-compact-*`, `--density-pad-*`, `--density-touch-*`) and the input's own as `--control-sm`, `--control-md`, `--control-lg`, `--row`, `--header`, `--gutter`, `--section`, with `--touch-target`; sizes and strokes (`--size-*`, `--stroke-edge`); shadows (`--shadow-*`: the design language's per scheme and the controls' `--shadow-sheen`, `-well`, `-pressed`, `-groove`, `-fill-sheen`, `-minimap`, `-slot-selected`, `-tab-selected`); glass (`--glass-blur-thick`, `--glass-blur-regular`, `--glass-saturation`); and the engine colours `--color-track`, `--color-minimap`, `--color-minimap-edge`, `--color-slot-selected-edge`. Each core control has its own tokens, `--<control>-<property>`: `--button-*`, `--field-*`, `--checkbox-*`, `--radio-*` and `--radio-card-*`, `--switch-*`, `--slider-*`, `--segmented-pad-ratio`, `--tabs-radius`, `--chip-radius`, `--dropdown-*`, `--menu-open-duration`, `--details-icon`, `--modal-width`, `--panel-*`, `--hud-radius`, `--slot-*`, `--meter-*`, `--keyboard-*`, `--joystick-size`, `--dpad-size`, `--action-size` and `--state-press-duration`. The defaults are the values drawn before, so no frame moves (docs/ui.md §3.1).
